_: Placement table for the character probe: the ONE home for where it draws (CLAUDE.md 2F). Read by harness/tools/char_probe_plan.py, which emits the 6809 draw list AND the predicted framebuffer from it. LEVEL0 screen 1's top floor: CharY = FloorY[block row 0] = 191-126-10 = 55 [TABLES.S:179-185]; a cel's bottom row is yco = CharY + Fdy [CTRLSUBS.S:823-828]. col = the REFERENCE frame's byte column (a mirrored draw is registered to the reference's mirror; the routine's own frame sits d px left of it). Columns are on block columns 4-8 (port bytes 33..67): floor underfoot (block columns 2-3 are a pit), clear of every foreground rectangle, of the gate bars bg_compose omits at block column 0, and of each other. P5.28: identity/shifted/mirrored of frame 15 ('stand', Fcheck $43, PL 0). P5.29 adds frame 1 ('run-4', Fcheck $C4: PL 1, drawn UNMIRRORED -- the half of the colour defect P5.28's gate could not show) and frame 3 ('run-6', CHTAB1 #3, apple_w 3 = ODD, MIRRORED -- the case where MLayGen's 7*apple_w shift decides the swap).
_p530: P5.30 adds two draws in the BOTTOM row, on its floor (CharY = FloorY[block row 2] = 191-10 = 181), at the two walls of the spike pit (block columns 2-4 open, port bytes 19..39): 'behind' at bytes 38..40 overlaps the $83 wall front of block column 5 (bytes 40..46) and is drawn MID -- before the foreground pass, so the wall must hide his right edge; 'control' at bytes 18..20 overlaps the $83 of block column 1 (bytes 12..18) and is drawn FLAT -- after the pass, P5.5's single undifferentiated order, so he stands in front of the wall. Same cel, same facing, mirror-image situations: the difference between the two IS the defect.
